description: This file contains route handlers and utility functions for user settings management in a Fastify server, including profile updates, email confirmation, social links validation, and user preferences.

methods.name: getWaitMessage
methods.description: Generates a message indicating how long a user must wait before requesting another authentication link.

methods.name: getWaitPeriod
methods.description: Calculates the remaining wait time in minutes based on the last sent time.

methods.name: isPictureWithProtocol
methods.description: Checks if a URL has a valid HTTP or HTTPS protocol.

methods.name: validateImageExtension
methods.description: Checks if a URL has a common image file extension.

methods.name: isValidPictureUrl
methods.description: Validates if a picture URL is either empty or has a valid protocol and extension.

methods.name: validateSocialUrl
methods.description: Validates social profile URLs against allowed domains.
